name: Samurai Steel (Tamahagane Billet Detail)
description: Artisanal 3D showcase of folded tamahagane steel. A heavy folded high-carbon steel billet displaying intricate flowing Damascus woodgrain patterns, resting on a quench block with glowing crimson hot temper lines and floating heat haze.
